navigation_steps.reason: Determine whether the repository root is a deployable Node.js application or a build/publish workspace.
navigation_steps.result: Root scripts build, test, publish and build samples, but expose no production start command. Root is the Nest framework workspace rather than an application workload.

navigation_steps.reason: Resolve the compilation scope referenced by the root build script.
navigation_steps.result: The compiler scope targets packages and integration code and maps multiple @nestjs packages, confirming a framework monorepo.

navigation_steps.reason: A root package manifest alone must not be promoted to a Kubernetes workload without a production execution path.
navigation_steps.result: Root workload candidate rejected; search runnable subprojects or samples instead.

navigation_steps.reason: Validate whether a child package exposes a production start command.
navigation_steps.result: Child package provides build, development start and production start scripts; start:prod resolves to node dist/main.

navigation_steps.reason: Map the compiled production entrypoint dist/main back to source and verify listener behavior.
navigation_steps.result: NestFactory creates AppModule and listens on TCP port 3000.

navigation_steps.reason: Runtime, build, production entrypoint and port are confirmed for the sample workload. Configuration, storage and external dependencies are not established by the inspected files.
navigation_steps.result: Stop with explicit unknown fields rather than broad-reading the framework repository.

reasons: Distinguishes framework workspace from deployable application
Root scripts have no production start path
Confirms packages and integration compilation scope
Maps package aliases and dist output
Root script explicitly names it under test:docker workflows
Must not be promoted to production deployment evidence without another production reference

design_findings.value: The repository root is a framework workspace; sample/01-cats-app is a runnable sample workload, not evidence that the repository root itself should be deployed.
Node.js >=20 with NestJS and the Express platform adapter for the inspected sample.
nest build produces dist output; the sample removes dist before build.
No runtime configuration reads established in the inspected files.
No persistent writable path established in the inspected files.
No external runtime service established for sample/01-cats-app from the inspected files.
No production container or Kubernetes deployment definition established for sample/01-cats-app.

scanner_misses.description: A scanner that treats every root package.json as a workload would misclassify a framework publishing workspace as a deployable application.
scanner_misses.needed_signal: Require an executable production path or child workload boundary before confirming a workload.

scanner_misses.description: Runnable samples contain valid listeners and start commands but must remain classified as samples unless the requested analysis scope explicitly targets them.
scanner_misses.needed_signal: Carry path semantics such as sample, example, demo and integration into workload confidence.

scanner_misses.description: integration/docker-compose.yml is referenced by test:docker scripts and should not count as production deployment evidence.
scanner_misses.needed_signal: Propagate the referencing script role into the referenced file classification.

rule_candidates.support: Root package scripts reveal whether the repository is an application, library, framework workspace or test harness.
rule_candidates.counterexample: A package may omit start scripts and still be invoked by Dockerfile or Procfile; apply fallback edges before rejection.

rule_candidates.support: nestjs/nest root is a build and publishing workspace while a child sample has a production start path.
rule_candidates.counterexample: Repositories started exclusively by external platform configuration need Procfile, container or deployment fallback inspection.

rule_candidates.support: Nest samples are runnable but are not the framework repository's deployable production workload.
rule_candidates.counterexample: A repository may intentionally consist only of a deployable example or starter; root documentation and release artifacts can raise confidence.

rule_candidates.support: sample/01-cats-app start:prod points to dist/main and src/main.ts confirms the listener.
rule_candidates.counterexample: Bundlers can rename or combine entrypoints; inspect build configuration when the source mapping is not direct.

stop_decision.reason: The first navigation-policy slice established repository classification, a child runnable sample, build, entrypoint and port. Broad reading was stopped because the root is a framework corpus and remaining design fields are not required to validate the initial navigation rules.

review.notes: Initial corpus observation based on pinned source files. Full repository inventory and independent second review remain pending.
